// diagnostic

E0412

Teaching: Jet has no `private`; privacy lives on `priv module` and `priv` fields

What

Teaching: Jet has no `private`; privacy lives on `priv module` and `priv` fields

Why

Privacy is a property of a module or a field, never of a single declaration

Fix

Delete `private`; move the declaration into a `priv module` if it must stay internal.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0412: tests/ui/vis_private_teaching.stderr.

Error [jet.ForeignPrivate]: Jet has no `private`
  --> tests/ui/vis_private_teaching.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | private fn helper() -> Int { 1 }
    | ^^^^^^^
 Why: Declarations are public by default; privacy belongs to a `priv module` or a `priv` field
 Fix: Delete `private`; move the declaration into a `priv module` if it must stay internal
